rows.07:27680: I took a mechanical pencil out of my pocket and pressed it against the portrait.{p}
rows.07:276f4: In that instant, the portrait I was holding was slashed open.{p}
rows.07:27744:
A carving knife★
Had I really come that close to taking a blow from this?
Arai stood there, his eyes bloodshot.
So it was one against two!
I might not be able to win...
But just then...{p}
rows.07:278bc:
It was Arai!
Blood was dripping between the fingers clutching his arm.
The carving knife fell from his hand.
Had I really come that close to taking a blow from this?
Just then...{p}
rows.07:27974:
"Eeeeeeeek☆"
Iwashita shrieked.
"I'll kill you!"
She flew at me.
In the blink of an eye, the knife was wrenched from my hand.
The next moment, that same knife was driven into my chest.
"Die! Die! Just drop dead!"
Iwashita kept screaming.
Just as she wished, I would soon be called up to Heaven.
...No, maybe I wasn't a good enough person to go to Heaven.
As I thought that, Iwashita's portrait caught my eye.
It was slashed clean in two.
Had my knife done that...?
That was my last conscious thought.{p}
rows.07:27b7c:
...I was tired.
There was no way I could win against people like these.
All the strength drained out of my body.
I didn't care anymore.
I sat down on the floor.
If I stayed here, someone would come for sure.
Hino, or one of his friends...
Even if they didn't find me, this time the Grim Reaper would come.
Because even now, the poison capsule had to be slowly dissolving inside my body.
But everything was just too much trouble now.
I hugged my knees and waited for the time to come.{p}
rows.07:27d10:
I thought about punching Iwashita.
But...
I just couldn't do it.
I could never hit a girl.
There had to be some other way without resorting to that.{p}What should I do?
rows.07:27e34:
Iwashita grinned.
"You... You laughed when you looked at me, didn't you? That's why."
"What★"
Would anyone really want to kill someone over something like that★
Besides, I didn't remember doing any such thing.
"Heh heh... It was the day of this year's entrance ceremony. You, a new first-year, smiled at me.
But don't misunderstand. It's not as if I'm angry."
Iwashita said.
Had she read my mind?
But that only made it harder to understand.
If she wasn't angry, why kill me?
"Heh heh, you don't understand? When I saw your smile, I fell in love with you.
That's why I want you all to myself."
Iwashita was beaming at me.
That was insane.
Could anyone really fall for someone like that?
Iwashita, standing in front of me, seemed like some eerie creature.
And at that moment...{p}
rows.07:28178:
As I fell, I turned around and saw Arai, carving knife in hand, staring at me.
I could hear Iwashita's voice.{p}
rows.07:28294:
"Where's the ampoule★"
I asked Iwashita.
"I don't know. I'm not even interested in that sort of thing.
Wouldn't Master Hino know?"
Iwashita answered curtly.
She didn't seem to be lying.
Did she really not know?{p}Then what should I do?
rows.07:28380:
"Where's the ampoule★"
I asked Iwashita.
"I told you I don't know, didn't I? Why do you keep asking me?"
That's right.
No matter how many times I asked, it would be a waste of time.{p}What should I do?
rows.07:28430:
I thought about letting Iwashita go.
But... wait a minute.
Hino aside, I had a feeling the scariest of the whole lot was this Akemi Iwashita.
She was the one I absolutely couldn't let get away.{p}What should I do?
rows.07:284ec:
I tried to tie Iwashita up.
But to do that, I'd have to get her to hold still.
Maybe I should scare her a little.{p}What should I say?
rows.07:285a0: "How dare you try to kill me! I'll put a curse on you☆"{p}
rows.07:285e4:
Iwashita gasped and went pale.
"What did you say?"
Even her voice trembled as she asked.
"I said I'll put a curse on you. I'll set an evil spirit on you!"
...Of course, there was no way I knew how to do anything like that.
But Iwashita seemed to take it seriously.{p}
rows.07:286d4:
"Go ahead and try! I'll drag you down with me."
Her eyes were blazing with fury.
It looked like she meant it.
She was too dangerous to go near like this.{p}What should I do?
rows.07:28760: "How dare you try to kill me! Maybe I should make you hurt☆"{p}
rows.07:287ac:
But Iwashita just grinned.
"You mean to scar a girl?
If you do, you'll have to take responsibility for me."
...What the hell is she talking about★{p}
rows.07:28844: Either way, this approach didn't seem to work.{p}What should I do?
rows.07:2887c: "How dare you try to kill me! I'll kill you☆"{p}
rows.07:28950: Either way, this approach didn't seem to work.{p}What should I do?
rows.07:28988:
I examined the table.
...Nothing seemed out of the ordinary.{p}Now, what should I do?
rows.07:289dc:
I examined the table.
Nothing seemed out of the...
Just then, someone grabbed my leg.
Iwashita had been hiding under the desk!{p}
rows.07:28a70:
"Die! Die! Die!"
She kept screaming.
I was terrified.
I tried to shake my leg free.
But my leg was locked in place, as if it were caught in a bear trap.
This was a girl's strength★
"Now☆"
Iwashita shrieked.
What★{p}
rows.07:28b88:
I decided to go to the library.
Come to think of it, going there was how all of this had started.{p}
rows.07:28ca0:

rows.07:28d9c:
I decided to go to the library.

rows.07:28e3c: I used the keys I'd brought from the staff room and went inside.{p}
rows.07:28e9c:
The memory of that day came flooding back.
If only I had never come here, I wouldn't be running around the school at night like this.
But there was no use saying that now.
I'd heard the library boasted quite a collection, and sure enough, there were a lot of books.
Searching this place was bound to take a good while.{p}What should I do?
rows.07:28fdc: I decided to search the desks.{p}
rows.07:28ffc:
That said, the desks here didn't even have drawers.
I was done searching in no time.{p}What now?
rows.07:2905c: The bookshelves stood along the north, east and south sides of the library.{p}Where should I start?
rows.07:290ec:
I decided to check the south side.
There were four bookshelves standing in a row.{p}Which one should I check?
rows.07:291b0:
There were so many books that it took quite a while.
...In the end, there was nothing.{p}Where should I search next?

There were four bookshelves standing in a row.{p}Which one should I check?
rows.07:292cc:
There were so many books that it took quite a while.
...In the end, there was nothing.{p}Where should I search next?
rows.07:29344: There were so many books that it took quite a while.{p}
rows.07:29378:
...Hm?
This one book was sticking out awfully far.
Was there something behind it★
I'd try pulling the book out...{p}
rows.07:293f0:
Whoa★
Something small leapt out at me!
The thing squeaked as it scurried off into the darkness.
It left behind lots of tiny scraps, like bits of gnawed paper.
A rat?
...That gave me a scare.{p}Pulling myself together, I'd check somewhere else.
